race.comment: MISO (6) came from well back to score convincingly in a BM82 over 1400m at the Parks circuit three back. Has subsequently struggled in black type races. Has a wide gate but is well in after the claim and possesses the class to take this out. FAST TEMPO (8) won three from four before making late ground for a close fifth over the mile at Murray Bridge recently. Today's trip is right in his wheelhouse. Big chance to bounce back to winning ways. ALPINE FLYER (11) hasn't won for over two years but her recent fifth in the Listed Balaklava Cup had merit. Cannot be ruled out. SHADY THINKER (10) put the writing on the wall last time out when beaten narrowly over 1400m at the Parks track. Ready to peak after three runs back.
